note: The bands the Cub plant has to land in, from docs/CUB-STAGE1.md, which derives each from published figures for the FMS Piper J-3 Cub 1400 mm (scripts/cub-derive.js prints the derived figures). Never widened to pass; argue in the derivation instead.

c1_level_75.source: level speed at 75 percent throttle, derived 13.4

c2_stall.source: sqrt(2W / rho S CLmax), derived 8.1; alphaStall is CLmax / CLalpha, 1.15 / 5.21, of the zero lift line

c4_top.source: level speed at full throttle, derived 18.4

c5_roll.source: full aileron from the fastest the Cub flies, as the helix angle pb/2V, derived 0.155 (152 deg/s at 12 m/s)

c6_turn.source: radius against V^2 / (g tan bank) at the bank and speed flown

c7_climb.source: full throttle, best over a sweep of airspeeds, derived 4.9 at 10.1 m/s

c8_throw.source: a throw at 10 m/s, 70 percent, for two seconds the up stick that trims 10 m/s (1.87 deg of elevator through the expo); airborne and flying after three

c9_chop.source: throttle off from cruise, pitch stick neutral: a glide, not a tumble

c10_phugoid.source: the phugoid root of the four state longitudinal model trimmed at the 11.2 m/s 65 percent holds, derived 7.1; the band is the Skyhunter's in proportion

c11_sideslip.source: full rudder, wings held level: -Cndr dr / Cnb, derived 13.5, the wind from the left

c12_yaw_rate.source: full rudder, ailerons centred: the Dutch roll step's peak rate, derived 39

c13_rudder_roll.source: full rudder, ailerons centred: bank after 2 s, the rudder's way, from dihedral; steady roll rate derived 25 deg/s

c14_prop_torque.source: static full throttle, rolling left: ideal disc power 0.152, bench electrical power 0.28

c15_pfactor.source: full throttle at 8.9 m/s, 1.1 Vs, at the 5.46 deg of body alpha level flight needs there, nose left: 1.6 T V sin(alpha) / Omega, derived 0.0136; the band is kappa from 1 to 3

c16_rest.source: the drawn model at rest, 11.0 deg and 0.146 m, 14.4 percent on the tail

c17_takeoff.source: full throttle on grass, tail up at about 7 m/s, rotated at 1.1 Vs: derived 6.2 m and 8.9 m/s (asphalt 5.9 m)

c18_straight.source: the same take off with the rudder centred: the tailwheel holds the line against the torque

c19_taxi.source: full right rudder at walking pace: wheelbase / tan(steer), 0.679 / tan 15 deg, derived 2.5, turning right

c20_landing.source: a powered approach, flare and hold the tail down: at rest on three wheels at C16's attitude, no hull contact

c21_prop_strike.source: full down elevator at full throttle on the take off roll: the aircraft pitches over its mains until the prop, which clears the grass by 25 mm level, strikes at about 9 deg nose down

c22_unmoved.source: the five inch's canonical replay hash, the wing's and the Skyhunter's recorded flight hashes in Node, all from before the Cub existed; the Cub must move none of them. Re-recorded for crash round 4 aero (#59), from its merged build, with the owner's sign-off on the stall after flying it: sky each cross the stall (docs/STALL-STAGE1.md, npm run stall:crossing); the five inch, the wing and the Slow Stick are unchanged

c23_cross_host.source: the Cub's recorded take off and flight, state trace hash, Node against headless Chrome
